browser_beta_wording: Play the Akalynth pre-alpha beta instantly in your browser — no install needed. The direct Android beta APK (v12) is available separately through the direct channel. F-Droid follows a separate signing path and is currently held at an older version.
direct_android_v12_wording: Direct channel (current v12): ... The direct Android beta APK (v12) is available separately through the direct channel.
fdroid_hold_wording: F-Droid is held pending signing authority (older version). ... F-Droid follows a separate signing and publication path and is currently held pending signing authority (older version than direct v12). It is not synchronized with the current beta.

forbidden_claim_check.note: Wording explicitly states separate paths and hold; notes not synchronized.
